summary:
Held 0 of today's 10 biggest UK/EU movers.

• 6 upside misses — ENR.DE +8%, IFX.DE +5%, ASM.AS +4%, STMPA.PA +4%, SPX.L +4%. These cleared the universe screen but no strategy picked them up; the morning brief either filtered them on a catalyst/RSI/earnings rule or had nothing positive to trigger an entry.

• 4 downside moves (BNR.DE -3%, ABF.L -2%, EL.PA -2%, BTRW.L -1%) are unreachable on a long-only basket — no mechanism to express a short or pair-trade.

• Most instructive miss: ENR.DE (+8.18%) — Unconfirmed: no Nov 12, 2026 article found. Most likely Siemens Energy's Q4 FY26 results and first FY27 guidance, which it had said would come in November, amid AI/data-center turbine demand. Why we passed: Outside any active strategy's universe: ENR.DE is a large-cap German industrial (DAX/MDAX-class, energy equipment) that no strategy lists. If earnings-driven, the gap-up happened at the open, so post-market signals came too late.
